message.content:
Desserts come in a rainbow of hues—there isn’t a single “color of the dessert.”  Depending on the ingredients and presentation, a dessert can be:

| Dessert | Typical Color(s) | Why |
|---------|------------------|-----|
| **Chocolate cake** | Dark brown, sometimes with a glossy chocolate glaze | Cocoa powder or melted chocolate |
| **Vanilla custard** | Creamy white | Milk, eggs, vanilla |
| **Fruit tart** | Bright reds, oranges, yellows, greens | Fresh fruit toppings |
| **Pavlova** | Pale pinkish‑white | Egg whites, sugar, whipped cream |
| **Mango sorbet** | Yellow‑orange | Mango puree |
| **Red velvet cake** | Deep red | Beetroot or red food coloring |
| **Macarons** | Pastel pink, mint green, lemon yellow, chocolate brown | Food dyes |
| **Cheesecake** | Creamy off‑white | Cream cheese base |
| **Ice cream** | Varies widely (brown, pink, blue, etc.) | Flavors and mix‑ins |

If you had a particular dessert in mind—say, a specific recipe or a dessert from a movie or a brand—let me know and I can give a more precise color description!
